Platform packages and services
ATLAS
CONTINUOUS EXTERNAL EXPOSURE MANAGEMENT
Atlas maps your entire external attack surface and validates exposures continuously, so your team only acts on what is real and exploitable.
Atlas reasons, chains vulnerabilities and exploits like a skilled attacker. Not just pattern matching CVEs, but analyzing and exploiting application behavior.
Exposures are validated, ensuring every notification from Hadrian is verified and exploitable.
Event-driven architecture makes sure that every change introduced triggers new tests.
Add-ons available:
Mergers and acquisitions assessment
Infostealers credential leak detection
PRICE BASED ON TOTAL ASSET COUNT
Book a demo
More info
NOVA
ON-DEMAND AGENTIC PENETRATION TESTING
Nova delivers penetration tests powered by agentic AI, replacing the delays and inconsistencies of traditional manual engagements.
Schedule pentests on your timeline, not your vendor's calendar. Launch whenever you need validation, not whenever they have capacity.
Expect more from your pentesting spend. Get faster, better, cheaper tests. One platform, one vendor.
See exactly what the AI is doing: reasoning, tests performed, evidence collected, with a transparency manual pentests can't match.
Full reporting included. Results map to SOC 2, ISO 27001 and NIS2.
3,000 EUROS PER TEST, BUNDLES AVAILABLE
